en.name: Daoke
en.ability: You start knowing a Minion in play. Once per game during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Minion you know, they die.

zh.name: 刀客
zh.ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一个在场的爪牙角色。每局游戏限一次，你可以在白天公开选择一名玩家：如果他是你得知的角色，他死亡。
